title: [PM seat] repo:cloud · seat 5 — 🟢 hotlong
body:
repo:cloud#5 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjPP1zuWBNq3nBXVei9

**本贴是 `repo:cloud` 车道座位 5 的权威登记。** 座位贴协议见 `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/seat-post-protocol.md`;只有在任座位 PM 编辑正文。

## 当前 PM

**🟢 `hotlong`** · session `session_01Q4EjjPP1zuWBNq3nBXVei9` · seat `repo:cloud#5` · seated at this post's creation (the platform's timestamp).

- **Why a fifth seat:** the maintainer summoned `/pm-dispatch cloud` in this session. Seats 1–3 are held by `os-warren` (#6026, #24145, #30278) and seat 4 by `os-bob` (#32003), so this is the lane's highest seat number plus one.
- **Maintainer ruling — the approval account sits this seat (verbatim, 2026-11-12, in session):** the seat asked whether `hotlong`, an account listed in `GOVERNED_APPROVERS`, may sit a seat against the SKILL.md invariant 「批准账号永不跑席位或作其关联用户」; the maintainer chose 「破例：用 hotlong 坐 seat 5」. Consequence recorded with the ruling: a governed (Tier H) PR this seat accepts is not approved by `hotlong`; its approval request goes to the other approver.
- **Scope — p1 only (the maintainer, verbatim: 「只做p 1」, and on re-seating 2026-11-19: 「入座，开信箱，暂时还是只派 p1」):** this seat claims only unassigned `pm:queue` cards labelled `priority:p1`, never a card claimed or routed to seats 1–4. (Superseded: 「只派发 p1 p2 卡」.) First-touch triage and the release board stay with seats 1–3.
- **Form:** a kept seat in a session the maintainer drives, with cloud-lane triage duties, on the maintainer's order (2026-11-15): 「本座位保留。后续做 cloud 车道的分诊。定时 45 分钟。」 `Patrol:` an hourly self-bound check-in into this session (the scheduler's floor is one hour, so the maintainer's 45 minutes runs hourly), `trig_0125m96nD4E4xKTYr2jmLjyZ`. `Mailbox:` objectstack-ai/objectstack#35365 (opened and subscribed 2026-11-19T06:25Z).
- **Deploys — only on the owner's word (verbatim, 2026-11-19, in session: 「什么时候部署你应该等我的指令。」):** this seat never deploys staging or production on its own; when a round's PRs have merged it tells the owner and waits.
- **Batch:** 3 (the skill default). Write pace: the fleet default.
